Academic Credit System
SeoulTech offers three(3) inbound programs
-
Exchange Program
: Students can enroll in up to six academic credit courses.
* Open to students enrolled at partner universities of SeoulTech.
* The Student Exchange Program at SeoulTech allows students from
partner
universities
to pursue their studies for one or two semesters at SeoulTech.
* Students who are officially nominated by their home universities will have the opportunity to apply for the Student Exchange Program at SeoulTech.
* Tuition will be waived under the student exchange agreement.
-
Visiting Program
: Students can enroll in up to six academic credit courses.
* Open to students enrolled at
both partner and non-partner
universities
of SeoulTech.
* Participants will have the chance to take credit courses to pursue their studies for one or two semesters at SeoulTech.
* Students must be officially nominated by their home universities.
* Although students in the Visiting Program are granted the same status as exchange students, they are not eligible for tuition waivers.
-
Internship-Based Inbound Program
: Students can enroll in one to two academic
credit courses
and
secure an internship opportunity
at a company.
* Designed for students from overseas universities interested in studying at SeoulTech for one or two semesters, with the additional opportunity of completing an internship.
* Open to students enrolled at
both partner and non-partner
universities
of SeoulTech.
* Participants will have the chance to take a basic Korean language course and partake in a cultural trip exploring Korean traditions.
* Although students in the Internship-Based Inbound Program are granted the same status as exchange students, they are not eligible for tuition waivers.
Eligibility
Students who wish to study at SeoulTech must be:
- Have completed at least two semesters at their home universities.
- Be enrolled as full-time students at their universities.
- Be nominated as an Inbound Program student by their home institution.
- Be able to study either in English or in Korean for at least one semester (4.5 months).
- Not have studied at other Korean universities in the
immediate preceding semester
. (This requirement is due to visa issues.)
Study Period_2025/2026
- Spring semester:  4 March - 23 June, 2025
- Fall semester: 1 September -  19 December, 2025
- Spring semester:  2 March - 19 June, 2026(Tentitive)
Application documents
- Online application (The application link will be sent to the student who are officially nominated by their home university.)
- Official Transcript
- A certificate of language proficiency(Enlish or Korean)
- Recommendation Letter
- Study Plan
- Copy of Valid Passport
